#include<cmath>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    int common = gcd(x, y);
    x /= common;
    y /= common;
    
    if (n >= y) {
        cout << x << "/" << y << "\n";
    } else {
        long double target = (long double)x / y;
        long double minDiff = target;
        int bestNum = 0;
        int bestDen = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long double val = i * target;
            long long floorVal = (long long)floor(val);
            
            long double diff1 = abs((long double)floorVal / i - target);
            long double diff2 = abs((long double)(floorVal + 1) / i - target);
            
            if (diff1 < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff1;
                bestNum = floorVal;
                bestDen = i;
            }
            if (diff2 < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff2;
                bestNum = floorVal + 1;
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
        
        cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
